sourceName: National Health and Aging Trends Study

currentDecision.reason: Official access, a first R13/R14 file-tier table, a controlled storage/destruction plan and a synthetic storage/destruction drill are documented, but registration, Colectica variable confirmation, survey-design plan, endpoint definition, disclosure control and governed storage execution are not complete.

officialSourceRefresh.observedFact: All NHATS data files require registration. Public-use files are available to registered users; sensitive and restricted files require additional application.
officialSourceRefresh.modelConsequence: No NHATS file can become acquisition-ready without registration status, user boundary and file-specific access tier.

officialSourceRefresh.observedFact: Cross-Year Search is provided through Colectica and requires separate registration; metadata includes item numbers, variable names, labels, values, value labels and question text.
officialSourceRefresh.modelConsequence: Exact model variables must be confirmed from Colectica or official codebooks before extraction.

officialSourceRefresh.observedFact: The Conditions of Use prohibit identification attempts, unapproved data sharing and uploads of NHATS or NSOC data to public LLMs or AI platforms; sensitive-data tabulations with n < 5 require suppression or additional restriction handling.
officialSourceRefresh.modelConsequence: Only aggregate non-disclosive outputs can leave a governed workspace, and public AI systems may not receive raw or row-level data.

officialSourceRefresh.observedFact: The official NHATS welcome page records a 2026-01-22 Conditions of Use update for public large language models and AI platforms and a 2026-04-06 edit to public-use data sharing conditions.
officialSourceRefresh.modelConsequence: The AI boundary must be treated as a current access condition, not as optional local preference.

officialSourceRefresh.observedFact: NHATS files pages expose file families, DOI metadata and approval boundaries, while data file availability must be rechecked immediately before acquisition.
officialSourceRefresh.modelConsequence: Round windows and file names remain incomplete until a fresh file-page review is recorded.

officialSourceRefresh.observedFact: Round 14 files include DOI metadata and file families for public annual data and sensitive or restricted resources that require approval.
officialSourceRefresh.modelConsequence: Round 14 can be considered only after public/sensitive/restricted status is attached to every planned file.

officialSourceRefresh.observedFact: Round 13 files include DOI metadata and file families for public annual data plus sensitive sample-person resources that require approval.
officialSourceRefresh.modelConsequence: Round 13 can be considered only after file tier and approval state are recorded.

gates.requiredEvidence: Date-stamped review of Data Access, Conditions of Use, Cross-Year Search, Files and relevant round-file pages.
gates.nextEvidence: Repeat immediately before registration, download or script work.

gates.requiredEvidence: Registered NHATS account identity, permitted user boundary and no-sharing obligations recorded outside the public repository.
gates.nextEvidence: Complete NHATS registration and record only non-sensitive registration status metadata.

gates.requiredEvidence: For each planned file, record public-use, sensitive or restricted tier, approval status and allowed local storage path.
gates.nextEvidence: Complete registration state, approval status, canonical format choice and governed storage path for the candidate R13/R14 annual files.

gates.requiredEvidence: Exact variable names, item numbers, labels, value labels, missing codes and question text from Colectica or official codebooks.
gates.nextEvidence: Fill one narrow functional-survival estimand variable table from Cross-Year Search.

gates.requiredEvidence: Selected rounds, file versions, release dates and cohort refresh handling fixed before extraction.
gates.nextEvidence: Choose the first development window and document why it fits the estimand.

gates.requiredEvidence: Weight, strata, cluster and replicate-weight strategy matched to the estimand.
gates.nextEvidence: Bind weight and design variables to the selected round window.

gates.requiredEvidence: Death, functional-survival, proxy interview, residential-care and censoring rules fixed before data access.
gates.nextEvidence: Pre-register endpoint and censoring rules before observing data.

gates.requiredEvidence: n < 5 suppression, aggregate-only export and no row-level output checks implemented.
gates.nextEvidence: Define local output validator before any derived export.

gates.requiredEvidence: Written rule that public AI tools may see only public docs, synthetic examples or aggregate non-disclosive outputs.
gates.nextEvidence: Operationalize with workspace policy and pre-export review.

gates.requiredEvidence: Governed local storage, access log, derived-data boundary and destruction-on-request process defined.
gates.nextEvidence: Execute the plan by provisioning a non-repository controlled workspace, initializing access/inventory logs outside the public repo and repeating destruction evidence inside the governed workspace before download.

allowedAiInputs: synthetic examples created without row-level NHATS or NSOC data
aggregate non-disclosive outputs that pass disclosure review
prohibitedActions: write extraction scripts before exact variables and file tiers are complete
place raw NHATS or NSOC data in this repository
upload raw or row-level NHATS or NSOC data to public LLMs or AI platforms
claim calibration or validation before governed cohort diagnostics exist

Execute the controlled storage/destruction plan in a governed workspace outside the public repository before any download.
Use Cross-Year Search or official codebooks to confirm exact variables for one functional-survival endpoint.
Define survey-design and disclosure-control plans before any extraction script exists.
Keep current decision at cannot-extract-yet until every gate is ready.
